mapper.sql: SELECT scheme_id, scheme_no, scheme_name, product_id, product_code, product_name, design_goal, main_params, file_url, scheme_status, final_time, final_by, dept_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pdm_scheme
mapper.select: SELECT formula_id, scheme_id, material_id, item_name, ratio, unit, tolerance, order_num, remark FROM pdm_scheme_formula WHERE scheme_id = #{schemeId} ORDER BY order_num ASC, formula_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pdm_scheme (scheme_no, scheme_name, product_id, product_code, product_name, design_goal, main_params, file_url, scheme_status, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{schemeNo}, #{schemeName}, #{productId}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{designGoal}, #{mainParams}, #{fileUrl}, #{schemeStatus}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})

INSERT INTO pdm_scheme_formula (scheme_id, material_id, item_name, ratio, unit, tolerance, order_num, remark) VALUES
(#{item.schemeId}, #{item.materialId}, #{item.itemName}, #{item.ratio}, #{item.unit}, #{item.tolerance}, #{item.orderNum}, #{item.remark})
mapper.delete: UPDATE pdm_scheme SET del_flag = '2' WHERE scheme_id IN #{schemeId}
